en-us:
More responsive video editing and complete split-clip commands.

- Modified preview avoids uploading the same decoded frame repeatedly. Playback and ruler scrubbing move the playhead without repeatedly redrawing every track.
- Ruler scrubbing combines pending seeks and retains the final frame on release. Drag a yellow marker to move it in one undoable edit.
- Split segments can be selected, copied, cut, deleted, moved and pasted independently. Use the clip context menu, toolbar overflow or Ctrl+C/X/V and Delete. Ctrl+B splits; V selects the move tool and B selects Blade.
- Linked audio follows split, copy, cut, delete and move operations, preserving its timing offset. Undo and redo restore the project together.
- High-resolution footage and complex effects remain dependent on your device. Generate a proxy for demanding footage.
